title: GetAlertedEventsRequest
description: GetAlertedEventsRequest schema from Varonis DatAlert API

alertId.description: Unique identifier of the alert to retrieve events for.

startTime.description: Start of the time range for event retrieval.

endTime.description: End of the time range for event retrieval.

lastDays.description: Retrieve events from the last N days.

extraFields.description: Additional fields to include in the response.

descendingOrder.description: When true, results are returned in descending order by time.
